title: My Childhood Memories
original_memory: When I was young, my grandmother used to tell me stories every evening. We sat outside our house and watched the sunset together.
story: When I was young, my grandmother used to tell me stories every evening. We sat outside our house and watched the sunset together. She would always tell me about her childhood, and I’d listen intently. Sometimes, she’d talk about her life as a farmer, and I’d imagine all the fields and the quiet of the countryside. Other times, she’d tell stories about her travels, and I’d feel a little bit like she was traveling with her. She loved to tell stories about the stars, and she’d always say they were like tiny diamonds scattered across the sky.  She had a special way of making the stories feel so real, even though they were just stories. It always made me feel loved and safe.
